7. Find value beyond money. Billy may have missed Doge millions, but he gained perspective. His take? "There's more to life than getting rich."

Wisdom: @BillyM2k certainly has valuable 2¢ to share

The Billy Markus story isn't just about #Dogecoin though... https://t.co/ee6Rk0L9ix

1. Create for fun, not profit. Dogecoin was magical because it never took itself seriously.

Lesson: Authenticity beats hype.

2. Know when to walk away. Leaving early saved Billy's sanity.

Lesson: Sometimes, the best move is a priceless exit. https://t.co/jI4mUQUYGg

Here's where it gets interesting:

Despite missing out on millions, Billy doesn't care.

Instead, he becomes Dogecoin's unexpected voice of reason.

His Twitter? A masterclass in humility, humor, and cutting through crypto BS.

The community loves him for it.

Fast forward to 2021. Dogecoin hits $0.70.

Billy's  3-hour coding session? Worth BILLIONS.

@elonmusk tweets about it. Mark Cuban accepts it for Mavs tickets.

But Billy's not laughing. He's watching from the sidelines. https://t.co/hSkxhVbdY1

Within days, $DOGE exploded.

A Reddit post sent it viral. Suddenly, Billy's inbox was flooded.

Investors, media, even celebs wanted in.

But there was a problem: Billy had no plan. No roadmap.

Just a meme and a prayer. So he did something unthinkable... https://t.co/O6WGFh5Z0S

It started with a 3 hour coding spree.

In 2013, Billy Markus @BillyM2k wanted to poke fun at Bitcoin hype.

His weapon of choice? A Shiba Inu dog meme. #Dogecoin was born.

But here's the kicker: What began as a joke quickly became deadly serious.. https://t.co/1ju1cYO9fN

He built a global brand with a dog and a dream.

Now $DOGE is in retirement portfolios.

He's the OG founding father of meme coin creators.

7 observations from the man who branded brilliance: https://t.co/mTPokbN8FX

Think about this. 

How many top meme coins are here from 2021? 

$SHIB $DOGE $FLOKI $BABYDOGE? 

That’s 4 out of THOUSANDS.

Most memes will not make it.

Most of #Crypto in general won’t make it.

But, there’s still money to be made. 

Stop holding the bag unless it’s #Bitcoin,
